```{r}
#| context: setup
# Everything on this dashboard comes from semantic/metrics.yml and the live warehouse.
# You should not need to edit this file: change metrics.yml, the gold SQL or config.yml instead.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(shiny); library(bslib); library(bsicons); library(plotly); library(DT) })
source("R/platform.R")
cfg  <- kit_config()
live <- file.path(cfg$db_dir, "warehouse.duckdb")
q <- function(sql) {                         # short-lived, read-only: the nightly swap is never blocked
  con <- connect(live, read_only = TRUE); on.exit(disconnect(con)); dbGetQuery(con, sql)
}
fmt <- function(x, f = "number") {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("–")
  compact <- function(v) { a <- abs(v)
    if (a >= 1e9) sprintf("%.2fbn", v / 1e9) else if (a >= 1e6) sprintf("%.1fm", v / 1e6)
    else if (a >= 1e4) sprintf("%.1fk", v / 1e3) else formatC(v, format = "f", digits = ifelse(a < 10, 2, 0), big.mark = ",") }
  switch(f %||% "number", currency = paste0(cfg$currency %||% "", compact(x)), pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", x), compact(x))
}
qid  <- function(x) paste0('"', gsub('"', '""', x), '"')            # quote an identifier
BRAND <- c("#0B2C55", "#E8A33D", "#7FA8D4", "#6FBFAE", "#9B8EC4", "#A9C86B", "#F2C14E", "#E58B3C")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# ---- refresh: watch the warehouse file; when the pipeline swaps in a new one, everything updates
stamp <- reactivePoll(cfg$refresh_seconds * 1000, session,
                      checkFunc = function() if (file.exists(live)) file.mtime(live) else 0,
                      valueFunc = function() if (file.exists(live)) file.mtime(live) else NA)
M <- reactive({ stamp(); read_metrics(cfg$metrics) })
ready <- reactive({ stamp(); file.exists(live) && length(M()$metrics) > 0 &&
                    !inherits(try(q(sprintf("SELECT 1 FROM %s LIMIT 1", M()$model$table)), silent = TRUE), "try-error") })
labels <- reactive(setNames(names(M()$metrics), vapply(names(M()$metrics), function(m) M()$metrics[[m]]$label %||% m, "")))

meta <- reactive({
  req(ready()); m <- M()
  rng <- q(sprintf("SELECT MIN(CAST(%s AS DATE)) lo, MAX(CAST(%s AS DATE)) hi FROM %s", m$model$time, m$model$time, m$model$table))
  vals <- lapply(m$model$dimensions, function(d)
    q(sprintf("SELECT DISTINCT CAST(%s AS VARCHAR) v FROM %s WHERE %s IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 500", qid(d), m$model$table, qid(d)))$v)
  list(lo = as.Date(rng$lo), hi = as.Date(rng$hi), vals = setNames(vals, m$model$dimensions))
})

output$notice <- renderUI({
  if (ready()) return(NULL)
  div(class = "alert alert-warning small", "No dashboard data yet. Finish the gold layer and semantic/metrics.yml, then run: Rscript run_pipeline.R")
})
first_fill <- reactiveVal(TRUE)
observe({                                     # fill and refresh the controls from metrics.yml and the warehouse
  req(ready()); m <- M(); mt <- meta()
  cur <- isolate(input$metric)
  updateSelectInput(session, "metric", choices = labels(), selected = if (isTRUE(cur %in% labels())) cur else unname(labels()[1]))
  start <- as.Date(format(mt$hi - 365, "%Y-%m-01")); start <- max(start, mt$lo)
  first <- isolate(first_fill())                # first time: last 12 full months; later: keep the user's choice
  updateDateInput(session, "from", value = if (first) start else isolate(input$from), min = mt$lo, max = mt$hi)
  updateDateInput(session, "to", value = if (first) mt$hi else isolate(input$to), min = mt$lo, max = mt$hi)
  if (first) updateSelectInput(session, "grain", selected = m$model$grain %||% "month")
  dims <- unlist(m$model$dimensions)
  updateSelectInput(session, "by", choices = dims, selected = if (isTRUE(isolate(input$by) %in% dims)) isolate(input$by) else dims[1])
  first_fill(FALSE)
})
dates <- reactive({ req(input$from, input$to); sort(c(input$from, input$to)) })
output$filters <- renderUI({
  req(ready()); mt <- meta()
  tagList(lapply(names(mt$vals), function(d)
    selectizeInput(paste0("f_", d), d, mt$vals[[d]], multiple = TRUE, options = list(placeholder = "All"))))
})

where <- reactive({
  d <- dates(); m <- M()
  w <- sprintf("CAST(%s AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE %s AND DATE %s", m$model$time, sq(format(d[1])), sq(format(d[2])))
  for (d in m$model$dimensions) { v <- input[[paste0("f_", d)]]
    if (length(v)) w <- c(w, sprintf("CAST(%s AS VARCHAR) IN (%s)", qid(d), paste(sq(v), collapse = ", "))) }
  w
}) |> debounce(400)

period_value <- function(metrics, from, to) {
  m <- M(); w <- where()[-1]
  w <- c(sprintf("CAST(%s AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE %s AND DATE %s", m$model$time, sq(format(from)), sq(format(to))), w)
  q(metric_sql(m, metrics, where = w))
}

output$kpis <- renderUI({
  req(ready()); d <- dates(); m <- M()
  ks <- names(m$metrics)[vapply(m$metrics, function(x) isTRUE(x$kpi), TRUE)]
  if (!length(ks)) ks <- head(names(m$metrics), 4)
  span <- as.numeric(diff(d)) + 1
  now  <- period_value(ks, d[1], d[2])
  prev <- period_value(ks, d[1] - span, d[1] - 1)
  boxes <- lapply(ks, function(k) {
    v <- now[[k]]; p <- prev[[k]]
    ch <- if (is.null(p) || is.na(p) || p == 0) "no comparison period"
          else if ((m$metrics[[k]]$format %||% "") == "pct") sprintf("%+.1f points vs previous %d days", v - p, span)  # a % changes in points
          else sprintf("%+.1f%% vs previous %d days", 100 * (v / p - 1), span)
    value_box(title = m$metrics[[k]]$label %||% k, value = fmt(v, m$metrics[[k]]$format), p(ch),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0B2C55", fg = "#FFFFFF"))
  })
  do.call(layout_column_wrap, c(list(width = 1 / length(boxes)), boxes))
})

output$trend <- renderPlotly({
  req(ready(), input$metric, input$grain); m <- M(); k <- input$metric
  if (isTRUE(input$split) && !is.null(input$by)) {
    top <- q(metric_sql(m, k, dims = qid(input$by), where = where()))
    top <- head(top[order(-top[[k]]), 1], 6)
    d <- q(metric_sql(m, k, dims = qid(input$by), grain = input$grain,
                      where = c(where(), sprintf("CAST(%s AS VARCHAR) IN (%s)", qid(input$by), paste(sq(top), collapse = ", ")))))
    names(d)[2] <- "group"
    plot_ly(d, x = ~period, y = d[[k]], color = ~group, colors = BRAND, type = "scatter", mode = "lines") |>
      layout(yaxis = list(title = names(labels())[labels() == k]), xaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(orientation = "h"))
  } else {
    d <- q(metric_sql(m, k, grain = input$grain, where = where()))
    plot_ly(d, x = ~period, y = d[[k]], type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", line = list(color = BRAND[1]),
            marker = list(color = BRAND[1])) |>
      layout(yaxis = list(title = names(labels())[labels() == k]), xaxis = list(title = ""))
  }
})

output$breakdown <- renderPlotly({
  req(ready(), input$metric, input$by); m <- M(); k <- input$metric
  d <- q(metric_sql(m, k, dims = qid(input$by), where = where()))
  d <- head(d[order(-d[[k]]), ], 15); names(d)[1] <- "group"
  plot_ly(d, y = ~reorder(group, d[[k]]), x = d[[k]], type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = BRAND[2])) |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = names(labels())[labels() == k]), yaxis = list(title = ""))
})

explore <- reactive({
  req(ready(), input$by); m <- M()
  d <- q(metric_sql(m, names(m$metrics), dims = qid(input$by), where = where()))
  names(d) <- c(input$by, names(labels())[match(names(m$metrics), labels())])
  d
})
output$table <- renderDT(datatable(explore(), rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
                           formatRound(-1, 2))
output$download <- downloadHandler(filename = function() paste0("export-", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
                                   content = function(f) utils::write.csv(explore(), f, row.names = FALSE))

read_log <- function(f) { p <- file.path(cfg$log_dir, f); if (file.exists(p)) utils::read.csv(p) else NULL }
output$run_status <- renderUI({
  stamp(); rh <- read_log("run_history.csv")
  if (is.null(rh)) return(p("No runs recorded yet."))
  last <- tail(rh, 1); pub <- tail(rh[rh$published %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"), ], 1)
  layout_column_wrap(width = 1 / 3,
    value_box("Last run", format(as.POSIXct(last$finished_at), "%d %b %H:%M"), p(last$status), showcase = bs_icon(if (last$status == "ok") "check-circle" else "x-octagon"),
              theme = if (last$status == "ok") "success" else "danger"),
    value_box("Data on screen published", if (nrow(pub)) format(as.POSIXct(pub$finished_at), "%d %b %H:%M") else "never", p("only gate-passed runs are published"),
              showcase = bs_icon("shield-check")),
    value_box("Runs recorded", nrow(rh), p(sprintf("%d published", sum(rh$published %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE")))), showcase = bs_icon("clock-history")))
})
output$tests <- renderDT({
  stamp(); th <- read_log("test_history.csv"); req(th)
  th <- th[th$run_id == tail(th$run_id, 1), c("status", "test", "failures", "severity")]
  datatable(th, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE)) |>
    formatStyle("status", backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL", "ERROR"), c("#DDF0E6", "#FCEBC8", "#F8D3CC", "#F8D3CC")))
})
output$manifest <- renderDT({
  req(ready())
  datatable(q("SELECT source, tbl AS bronze_table, rows, loaded_at FROM ops.load_manifest ORDER BY source"),
            rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "tip"))
})
output$freshness <- renderUI({
  req(ready()); mt <- meta()
  p(class = "small text-muted", sprintf("Data from %s to %s. Warehouse built %s.", mt$lo, mt$hi,
                                        format(file.mtime(live), "%d %b %Y %H:%M")))
})
output$definitions <- renderDT({
  m <- M()
  d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(m$metrics), function(k) { x <- m$metrics[[k]]
    data.frame(metric = x$label %||% k, definition = x$description %||% "", sql = x$sql, owner = x$owner %||% "",
               status = x$status %||% "exploratory") }))
  datatable(d, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50))
})
```
